shortDescription: Builds source-linked Word document indexes, chronologies, privilege logs and inconsistency maps from supplied matter documents without deciding credibility, privilege or merits.
longDescription: Uses a native structured document-review table when available to work through supplied legal matter documents, then creates Word deliverables for practitioner review: a numbered document index with descriptions taken from the documents themselves, an event-level chronology with source pinpoints, uncertainty and conflicting accounts preserved, a candidate-only privilege log recording roles, purpose on the face, circulation and waiver flags, and a fact-by-source inconsistency map that quotes each competing passage. No workflow decides relevance, privilege, credibility, evidentiary weight, admissibility, legal effect or merits, and every output remains subject to human review.
defaultPrompt: Build a numbered, source-linked document index as a .docx file from these matter documents.
Build a source-linked evidence chronology as a .docx file from these matter documents and preserve conflicting accounts.
Prepare a candidate-only privilege log as a .docx file from these documents and leave every claim to me.
Map where these sources agree, diverge or are silent on each material fact as a .docx file, without deciding which account is right.
whatItDoes: Inventories supplied documents into a numbered .docx index with stable source identifiers and duplicate, version and attachment links
Extracts source-linked event candidates through a structured review table and creates an event-level .docx chronology with conflicts and evidence gaps preserved
Prepares a .docx privilege log that records roles, purpose on the face, circulation and waiver flags per document, with every basis labelled candidate
Builds a .docx fact-by-source inconsistency map with a divergence register and corroboration register
boundaries: Does not decide relevance, privilege, waiver, credibility, weight, admissibility, legal effect or merits
Does not claim completeness beyond the supplied and readable documents
A human reviewer verifies every material row, pinpoint and candidate claim
